posts.cooked:
Gazes upon the trash pile

 

That is indeed wonderous.  And hilarious.

 

Since La Capitan's self-damage was prevented, is the damage reduction caused by Cortex Hyperstimulator still around?  (This is a rules question that has not been satisfactorily resolved, so Oaktree should probably just decide what should be done.)

posts.name: Oaktree
posts.cooked:
jsz2:

. 

Gazes upon the trash pile That is indeed wonderous.  And hilarious. Since La Capitan's self-damage was prevented, is the damage reduction caused by Cortex Hyperstimulator still around?  (This is a rules question that has not been satisfactorily resolved, so Oaktree should probably just decide what should be done.)

I think it is, and it's per turn as well.  In this case, due to Imbued Fraility adding +1 damage the damage reduction from Cortex Hyperstimulator would drop the self-inflicted damage to zero in any case - so the prevent via discard would kick in.  Without Imbued Fraility I can see the case where you can argue that the DR makes the self-attack zero damage and thus would not trigger the discard.  (Followed by discussion that order of application comes into play, yadda yadda yadda.)

I will, for the length of this game, rule that the prevent kicks in before the DR.  Thus treating it like the Spiff ruling on the advanced power that does the redirect.  The advanced power, and Cortex Hyperstimulator, are both in order after the prevent via discard effect - so it kicks in first.  Being somewhat consistent in regards to this side of La Capitan's character card.
